C.label: Local Custom Components
C.constraint: Only when A and B do not fit

hardRules: NEVER hand-roll Alert, Dialog, Tabs, Switch, Select when primitive is available
NEVER import from @radix-ui/react-* directly — use ONLY @/components/ui/* paths
AlertDialog = modal confirmation or destructive decision — do NOT confuse them
Do NOT use uploaded assets as decorative noise
Do NOT use premium components outside allowed surfaces
Do NOT invent components not in advertised catalog

protoPipeline.position: after attachmentPromptBlock, before identity substitution contract

lvPipeline.position: after SHOULD IMPLEMENT block, before OUTPUT FORMAT

assetMaterialization.uploadedImages: generated/uploads/<id>.ts with export const uploadedAsset + export default dataUrl
assetMaterialization.uploadedOther: generated/uploads/<id>.ts with export const uploadedAsset metadata + export default
assetMaterialization.lvPipelineOverlay: Materialized files overlaid in merged map before compile
